question: How is the divine lotus of the first octad described in meditation?
premises: A lotus is described as divine
The lotus has eight spokes or petals
It is adorned by the first octad
inference: The meditation presents a divine eight-spoked lotus adorned by the first octad.
uncertainties: āraṃ may indicate spokes or petals depending on context
plain_english: Meditate on the divine eight-spoked lotus adorned by the first octad.
